ff-cleaning-maintenance-1.front: Tikka: how soon can corrosion start?
ff-cleaning-maintenance-1.back: Within 24 hours, even on stainless and all weather rifles.
ff-cleaning-maintenance-1.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="A clock reading 24 hours. Tikka says corrosion can begin within 24 hours if a rifle is not cleaned after use, even stainless and all weather models. Clean after every use, even if you did not fire.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Rust can start within 24 hours</text><circle cx="120" cy="160" r="80" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M120 160 L120 94" fill="none" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M120 160 L170 182" fill="none" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="120" y="270" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#b3261e" text-anchor="middle">24 h</text><text x="290" y="110" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Even stainless</text><text x="290" y="130" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">and all weather</text><text x="290" y="150" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">rifles (Tikka)</text><text x="290" y="200" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">Clean after every</text><text x="290" y="219" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">use, even with</text><text x="290" y="238" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">no shot fired</text>
</svg>

ff-cleaning-maintenance-2.back: After every use, even with no shot fired (Tikka).

ff-cleaning-maintenance-4.front: Which way does the rod go?
ff-cleaning-maintenance-4.back: From the breech, through a bore guide, in the bullet direction.
ff-cleaning-maintenance-4.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="The cleaning rod goes in from the breech, through a bore guide that keeps it centred, and pushes in the bullet direction toward the muzzle. This protects the crown and the throat.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Rod from the breech, through a guide</text><rect x="120" y="130" width="260" height="30" rx="0" fill="#9a9e96" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="80" y="122" width="50" height="46" rx="0" fill="#6b6f68" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="40" y="136" width="60" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f8e3cf" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="70" y="196" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">bore guide</text><line x1="0" y1="145" x2="360" y2="145" stroke="#6b4f35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="105" x2="350" y2="105" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M341.9 108.9 L350 105 L341.9 101.1" fill="none" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="250" y="95" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">bullet direction only</text><text x="200.0" y="270" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Protects the crown and the chamber throat</text>
</svg>

ff-cleaning-maintenance-5.back: Locking lugs, cocking cam, head of the cocking piece. Lightly.

Everything else: a thin film of oil.</text>
</svg>

ff-cleaning-maintenance-6.back: Wipe the chamber dry and run a dry patch.

ff-cleaning-maintenance-7.back: At least once a year, more with heavy use or before storage.

ff-cleaning-maintenance-8.back: Can make the barrel shoot inaccurately and corrode more easily.

ff-cleaning-maintenance-9.back: Out of the case, dry it warm, then clean and oil.
ff-cleaning-maintenance-9.diagram:

</svg>

ff-cleaning-maintenance-10.front: Why no leather or fabric case for storage?
ff-cleaning-maintenance-10.back: They attract moisture even when they look dry (Tikka).

ff-cleaning-maintenance-11.back: Remove oil from accessible parts or use a lube made for the cold.

ff-cleaning-maintenance-12.front: Cold rifle into a warm cabin?
ff-cleaning-maintenance-12.back: Water beads form. Leave it cased somewhere cold and secure, or dry it well (Tip).
